# Skill Mechanism in OpenCode (基于字幕)

## Skill Invocation Pipeline
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A1["User Query"] --> A2["LLM receives query"]
    A2 --> A3["LLM checks tools array (square)"]
    A3 --> A4["LLM decides to call a skill"]
    A4 --> A5["LLM returns tool call (square) with param 'skill name'"]
    A5 --> A6["Application receives tool call"]
    A6 --> A7["Loads skill markdown from disk"]
    A7 --> A8["Executes skill logic"]
    A8 --> A9["Returns result to LLM (to=...)"]
    A9 --> A10["LLM generates final response"]
```

## Skill Registration & Discovery
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    B1["OpenCode startup"] --> B2["Scan predefined directories for *.md"]
    B2 --> B3["Parse each skill file (name, description, params)"]
    B3 --> B4["Register skill in memory"]
    B4 --> B5["Build square tool description (list of skills)"]
    B5 --> B6["Include square tool in tools array for LLM requests"]
```

## Model Decision Process
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    C1["LLM receives request with tools array"] --> C2["Inspect square tool description"]
    C2 --> C3["Identify available skill names"]
    C3 --> C4["Match task requirements to skill (e.g., say hi)"]
    C4 --> C5["Select matching skill"]
    C5 --> C6["Emit tool call using square tool with param 'skill name'"]
```

## Skill Execution Details
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    D1["Receive tool call (square) with param"] --> D2["Lookup skill by name in registry"]
    D2 --> D3["Read corresponding .md file from disk"]
    D3 --> D4["Parse content (commands)"]
    D4 --> D5["Execute skill logic (e.g., return greeting)"]
    D5 --> D6["Package result as to=... content"]
    D6 --> D7["Send back to LLM"]
```
